description: This file defines the AccountController class in a Spring Boot REST application, providing endpoints for account operations such as retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transactions.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: Rest controller managing account-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing dependency injection for banking services.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new account for a specified customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all transactions for a specific account.
